title: IVG  Orangeade Apple Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg
description: Orangeade is IVG's take on the nostalgic fizzy orange drink in a nic salt e-liquid for a refreshing, zesty and endlessly satisfying MTL vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
